d: Who is really backing the Houthis as attacks target Saudi Arabia’s oil and military infrastructure? Firstpost examines allegations that Russian satellite intelligence helps Iran and its allies identify targets. Findings by Geneva-based Aurora Geosignal Intelligence point to Russian satellite activity around areas hit by missile and drone strikes. Meanwhile, Drop Site News alleges that the UAE provides intelligence support to Houthi-linked operations in Yemen, amid growing tensions between Abu Dhabi and Riyadh.
